theory.intro: A full turn around a circle is $360^{\circ}$, so two angles that differ by a whole number of full turns point in exactly the same direction — they are equivalent (coterminal). Any angle can be rewritten as an equivalent angle in the range $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
facts: A full revolution is $360^{\circ}$. Adding or subtracting $360^{\circ}$ does not change the direction the angle points.
Two angles are **coterminal** (equivalent) when they differ by a whole number of $360^{\circ}$ turns.

Watch the boundary: an angle that reduces to exactly $360^{\circ}$ is rewritten as $0^{\circ}$, because $360^{\circ}$ is outside the range $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$ and points the same way as $0^{\circ}$.

foundation.question_text: Rewrite $400^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $480^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-30^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-160^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-90^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $360^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $750^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-420^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.

development.question_text: Rewrite $810^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-500^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $1000^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
Rewrite $-765^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.

development.solution_text:
Rewrite each in the range $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
$400^{\circ}\equiv 400^{\circ}-360^{\circ}\equiv 40^{\circ}$
$-320^{\circ}\equiv -320^{\circ}+360^{\circ}\equiv 40^{\circ}$
Both reduce to $40^{\circ}$, so yes, they are equivalent.

development.question_text: Rewrite $1080^{\circ}$ as an equivalent angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$.
A wheel turns through $930^{\circ}$ from its starting position. Rewrite this as an angle where $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$ to describe its final position.
development.solution_text:
$930^{\circ}$
$\equiv 930^{\circ}-360^{\circ}$
$\equiv 570^{\circ}$
$\equiv 570^{\circ}-360^{\circ}$
$\equiv 210^{\circ}$
The wheel finishes at the $210^{\circ}$ position.

practice.masteryOmitted: Single-step reduction atom: add or subtract $360^{\circ}$ until the angle lands in $0^{\circ}\le\theta<360^{\circ}$. Larger magnitudes only repeat the same step, and coterminal recognition is already covered in the practice tiers, so there is no deeper in-skill twist.
